title: Ukrainian Bible, translation of Ivan Ohiienko (Українська Біблія, переклад Івана Огієнка), full Bible, one verse per line
notes: License stated as 'Public Domain' in the source README at https://github.com/scrollmapper/bible_databases/blob/59b18c5af5845728c275d5b7178ad0d024172b1f/sources/uk/UkrOgienko/README.md (scrollmapper/bible_databases, files from the CrossWire SWORD module UkrOgienko). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 6,633,481 bytes; one verse per line as '[c:v] text' with '### Book' headings in English (66 short headings, negligible). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'ukrainian') gives 3,286,908 characters. Combining marks (e.g. the breve of й) are stripped by the generic normalization. Caveat for reviewers: the README (and the CrossWire module) state Public Domain; Ohiienko died in 1972 and the translation was published in 1962, so readers in life+70 jurisdictions may weigh the stated licence accordingly. The UBS has distributed it freely for decades.
